findings.note: Instrument fix, no row is owed. GAP LINE 1 of family instruments-2 (test/wg-experience.harness.test.tsx — classFeatureHost's ownedAt20 calls classFeatureIdsOwned with no classChoices) is CLOSED IN CODE, in the file the line names. The owner-search half was authored by the gap agent for family instruments-1, working the same defect in the same file concurrently: classFeatureHost now falls back to scanning cls.extraChoices[].options for the record's id, seats that one pick on the WITH build (primaryApparition with it, for the apparition group) and seats an empty group on the WITHOUT build ('extra-choice-unpicked'). I did NOT re-route ownedAt20 itself: giving classFeatureIdsOwned every option as classChoices would make the FIRST loop answer 'owned' and break before that new fallback runs, leaving `extra` null and the pick unseated — a silent regression of the fix that closes this line. The second half, and the half these five apparitions actually needed, is mine: minimalHost's extra-choice prefill was DEAD (the `...emptyBuild()` spread sat after it and reset extraChoices to {} and primaryApparition to null), so a seated host still built with nothing answered anywhere else. Measured after both halves, on the real harness (WG_EXPERIENCE_BATCH over the five): all five now report supported:true, 22 pages, 98 controls, 32 attributable sheet changes each — both Lores at master, the ten-spell ladder in the apparition entry and the vessel spell in the focus pool.
